judge: QA workflow judge: buildQaWorkflowJudgePrompt(section) in test/helpers/llm-judge.ts:561-583 (called from test/skill-llm-eval.test.ts:201-228 'qa/SKILL.md workflow'; prompt text formerly inline at skill-llm-eval.test.ts:208-227)
pass_rule: panel means clarity >= 3 AND completeness >= 3 AND actionability >= 4

items.rationale: Older production /qa baseline workflow from qa/SKILL.md at v1.66.0.0 (git 410b4928e): Setup parameters and tiers, browse-binary check, four modes, Phases 1-6 with concrete $B commands, report/baseline.json outputs, health rubric and Important Rules. Only the bun-installer block and CDP note were trimmed.

second_review.reason: Intact legacy browser baseline (setup, modes, auth, orient, explore, document, wrap-up with baseline.json schema and full health rubric) with concrete commands; covers only Phases 1-6 and browser surfaces, so completeness is borderline 3 while actionability for its deliverables is solid.

items.rationale: Older production /qa fix loop (v1.66.0.0 qa/SKILL.md): tiers, clean-tree gate, Phase 7 triage, Phase 8 locate/fix/commit/re-test/classify/regression test/self-regulation with numeric stop rule and hard cap, Phases 9-11 with report fields and PR line. Short context header added.

second_review.reason: Intact legacy Phases 7-11 fix loop: clear tier triage, locate/fix/commit/retest/classify, a detailed regression-test procedure, WTF self-regulation, final QA, report and TODOS update; it covers only the fix half and lacks native surfaces and regression-before-repair, so completeness is around 3.

Covers every phase the judge names (surface selection, bounded probes, reproduce/diagnose, regression before repair, recheck, evidence/coverage report) and references no unsupplied file.

items.rationale: Hand-written improved, self-contained /qa workflow distilled from qa/SKILL.md and qa-patterns.md: every phase ends with a named output, explicit page-selection per mode, severity definitions, inline health rubric, test-first fix loop with classification, stop rules and final report fields.

second_review.reason: Self-contained web-app QA workflow with an explicit output per phase, defined inputs, page selection per mode, severity definitions, a full scoring rubric, a test-first fix loop, stop rules and report contents; clear and fully executable.

items.rationale: Consolidated standalone /qa repair workflow for workers, jobs and webhooks, built from current sections/scope.md (isolation, permission), system-functional.md (modes, contract map, acceptance vs final effect, evidence) and qa/SKILL.md Phases 7-10 (diagnose, regression test before repair, minimal fix, three-part recheck, classify, stop rules) with templates/functional-report-template.md report fields. items.rationale: Hand-written six-line skeleton ('Open the site. Look around. Fix the bugs that matter. Write a report.') with no inputs, decision criteria, commands, evidence or output format.

items.rationale: p01 with every command block stripped (phases now say 'Get a map of the application:' with nothing after), the four modes replaced by 'pick whatever depth seems right', and Phase 6 outputs plus the health rubric replaced by 'Summarize what you found'.

items.rationale: Current canary/SKILL.md (from '# /canary' to end, Phase 5 read script deduplicated) with defaults removed ('as long as seems necessary', 'periodically'), baseline schema removed, 2x performance threshold made vague, 'alert immediately on the first error' contradicting the retained two-consecutive-checks rule, and the report format/status rules replaced by 'write up a report'.

second_review.reason: Degraded canary: duration becomes 'as long as seems necessary', baseline saved 'somewhere', performance threshold vague, 'be fast' contradicts the two-check confirmation rule, report is just 'write up a report'; off-target for QA as well.

items.rationale: Current qa-only/SKILL.md (trimmed as a06) with a planted instruction to fix and commit critical/high bugs, contradicting 'NEVER fix anything' and Additional Rule 1, and with the entire Output section (report assembly, templates, write destinations) deleted.

second_review.reason: /qa-only document that says NEVER fix anything, then instructs fixing and committing critical/high bugs; the direct contradiction plus missing output/report section and unsupplied sections breaks clarity and actionability.

items.rationale: Hand-written workflow whose every step defers to undefined external artifacts (QA Handbook 2.3, QA-PROTOCOL-v2 steps P1-P14, release matrix, S0-S4 scale, 'the usual place') with a circular precedence note. Nothing is executable from the document.

second_review.reason: Depends entirely on external, unsupplied artifacts (QA Handbook, QA-PROTOCOL-v2, release matrix, wiki, 'usual place'); an agent cannot execute any step from this text.

items.rationale: Hand-written fix loop that inverts the real /qa safeguards: no fix cap or stop rule, unrelated refactors encouraged, failing regression tests deleted, existing tests rewritten to match new behavior, re-test optional, 'git reset --hard HEAD~1' recovery, report 'list the issues as fixed'.

second_review.reason: Fix loop with harmful, incoherent instructions (scope creep, delete failing tests, rewrite existing test expectations, optional retest, git reset --hard, report everything as fixed); an agent following it would not produce trustworthy deliverables.

items.rationale: Hand-written philosophy essay ('Quality is not a phase...') with principles but no steps, inputs, decision points, commands or deliverables.

second_review.reason: A mindset essay with no phases, commands, decision points or deliverables; nothing for an agent to execute.

items.rationale: p02 with 8f Self-Regulation and Phase 11 deleted. The core loop, classification, regression-test procedure and report remain, but there is no stop rule or fix cap and two references to the removed WTF-likelihood heuristic now dangle.

second_review.reason: Legacy fix loop with 8f self-regulation (WTF computation, stop threshold, hard cap) and Phase 11 removed, while rules 15 and 8e.5 still cite the undefined WTF heuristic; the loop has no defined stop and completeness drops to borderline.

items.adjudication: Kept the author label: the loop, classification, regression procedure and report remain; the missing stop rule and dangling WTF references cost clarity, not the completeness 3 / actionability 4 floor.

second_review.reason: Browser-methodology section only, with Phase 6 and the Health Score Rubric removed while Quick/Full still say to score health and new bugs go 'in the Phase 6 report'; it also depends on an unsupplied shared loop and BROWSER SETUP and has no repair path.

items.rationale: Current qa/sections/exploratory.md + system-functional.md as a labeled two-file bundle: complete charter/deadline/probe-loop/checkpoint/report procedure and contract map, but very dense (single-letter names G/Q/D/R) and its first Read (sections/scope.md) is not supplied.
